text_en: Growing up is an exciting journey.
When you are a baby, your parents do everything for you.
As you get older, you learn to do more things on your own.
You learn to tie your shoes, make your bed and pack your school bag.
Later, you will be able to cook simple meals and look after younger children.
Growing up also means being responsible.
You keep your promises, help at home and manage your time.
Sometimes you will fail, but you can learn from your mistakes.
The most important thing is to believe in yourself and never give up.

questions.q: What do your parents do when you are a baby?
What does growing up also mean?
What is the most important thing?
options: To believe in yourself and never give up.
To be the best at everything.
questions.answer: To believe in yourself and never give up.
